guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: the weekly capacity, the load share that counts as overloaded, the coordinator hour cost, the crew rate and the hiring trigger.
Check Team: the owner planner, the coordinators and the freelance crew with weekly hours, pay and hour cost. Open tasks, overdue tasks, hours and free hours fill in by themselves.
Keep Events current: lead, status, guests and planning fee. Planned hours, hours logged, the fee per hour and the handover date fill in.
Create the tasks of a new event from Task Templates and Task Due Dates, then enter them on Tasks with an owner, a due date and an estimated time.
Log hours on Staff Hours the same day. They feed Weekly Capacity, Labour Cost by Event, Workload by Person and Productivity Summary.
Read Weekly Capacity every Monday: planned hours against the hours available, with leave taken off, and the load check.
Record every late or stuck task on Overdue and Blocked with the reason, the new due date and who helps.
Plan every event on Event Staffing Plan with a second coordinator and the crew, and book the crew on Freelance Crew Bookings.
Enter leave on Leave with who covers. Events Affected shows the events of that person in those days.
Use Training and Skills, Performance and Team Meetings to keep reviews, feedback and decisions with owners and dates.
Keep Payroll, Owner Pay and Hiring Plan up to date. Hiring Trigger and New Coordinator show when to hire and what it costs.

Use the 14 calculators before you decide: capacity check, hours needed, fee yield, overload finder, task due dates, day staffing, overtime, hiring, new coordinator, crew cost, leave cover, clash check, payroll and a team size what-if grid.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open a chat with the text already written (28 messages).
Read Team and Capacity Dashboard and Charts every week: tasks, hours, load, labour cost, payroll and the fee per hour.

listing.title: Wedding and Event Planner Team Excel Template: Tasks, Staff Hours, Weekly Capacity, Labour Cost per Event, Payroll and Hiring
listing.headline: Know who is overloaded and what each event costs in labour
listing.description:
Run the team of your planning business from one Excel workbook. Tasks lists every task of every event with its owner, due date and status, and the days late and the overdue flag fill in by themselves. Staff Hours feeds Weekly Capacity, where each coordinator shows the hours available with leave taken off, the hours planned, the hours worked, the load share and an overload flag.

Labour Cost by Event shows the hours, the labour cost and the planning fee per hour of every event, with a flag when the fee does not cover the labour. Event Staffing Plan gives every event a lead, a second coordinator, a crew and planned hours, and warns when there is no second coordinator. Task Templates hold 19 steps for each event type and a calculator counts them back from the event date.

Overdue and Blocked records why a task is stuck and who helps, Leave shows the events affected and the cover, Event Ownership Calendar flags one person on two events, and Training and Skills tracks review dates. Payroll, Owner Pay, Freelance Crew Bookings and Productivity Summary show what the team costs against the contract value, and Hiring Plan shows when to hire and the break-even.

14 calculators cover the capacity check, hours needed, fee yield, overload, due dates, staffing for the day, overtime and time off, the hiring trigger, a new coordinator, crew day cost, leave cover, clash check, payroll month and a team size what-if. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready messages with the details already written in.

This is part seven of the Wedding and event planner suite. A standard Excel workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data to explore first. Money is shown in one plain currency. It helps you plan and does not promise results.

messages.text: Hello, {person} is over capacity in the week of {week}: {planned} hours planned, {available} available.

messages.moment: Owner: how much room a person has
messages.text: Hello, {name} has {free4} free hours in the next four weeks and {open_tasks} open tasks.

messages.moment: Owner: an event has no second
messages.text: Hello, {event_id} ({event_name}) on {event_date} has no second coordinator. {lead} leads it alone.

messages.moment: Owner: planning hours are over plan
messages.text: Hello, {event_id} has {labour_hours} hours logged against {planned_hours} planned. Fee per hour: {fee_per_hour}.

messages.moment: Owner: overdue tasks of a person
messages.text: Hello, {name} has {overdue} overdue tasks and {open_tasks} open tasks.

messages.moment: Owner: the hiring trigger is reached
messages.text: Hello, the hiring trigger is reached for the role {role}. Needed from {needed_from}; break-even {break_even} events a year.

messages.moment: Owner: payroll and owner draw are ready
messages.text: Hello, payroll for {month} is ready: {month_total}. Owner draw of the month: {owner_draw}.

messages.moment: Lead: a new event is assigned to you
messages.text: Hello {lead}, a new event is assigned to you: {event_id} ({event_name}) on {event_date}, {guests} guests.

messages.moment: Lead: the handover is due
messages.text: Hello {lead}, the handover of {event_id} is due on {handover_due}. Please send the handover note.

messages.moment: Lead: one person on two events
messages.text: Hello {lead_a}, there are two events on {date} ({event_a} and {event_b}) and one person is on both. Please check the staffing.

messages.moment: Lead: the weekly workload report
messages.text: Hello, the weekly workload report is attached. {person} has {planned} hours planned in the week of {week}.

messages.moment: Lead: cover is needed
messages.text: Hello {covered_by}, please cover for {person} from {from_date} to {to_date}. {events_affected} events are affected.

documents.title: Task list for an event
paragraphs: Task list of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Event {col:events.event_id}: {col:events.name} on {col:events.date} at {col:events.venue}, {col:events.guests_now} guests. Lead: {col:events.lead}. Second coordinator: {col:events.second}.

Open tasks: {col:events.open_tasks}. Tasks due in the next days: {col:events.due_week}. Hours planned: {col:events.planned_hours}. Hours logged so far: {col:events.labour_hours}. Hours check: {col:events.hours_flag}.
Every task with its owner and due date is on the attached sheet. Please tell the lead the same day if a task is stuck.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Weekly workload report
paragraphs: Weekly workload report of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Person: {col:cap.person}. Week starting {col:cap.week}.
Hours available: {col:cap.available}. Hours planned: {col:cap.planned}. Hours worked: {col:cap.worked}. Load share: {col:cap.load_share}. Free hours: {col:cap.free}. Load check: {col:cap.flag}.
When the load check shows overloaded, the lead coordinator moves tasks to a colleague with free hours before the week starts.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Event staffing plan
paragraphs: Event staffing plan of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Event {col:staffing.event_id}: {col:staffing.event_name} on {col:staffing.event_date}, {col:staffing.guests} guests.
Lead: {col:staffing.lead}. Second coordinator: {col:staffing.second}. Crew on the day: {col:staffing.crew}. Planned hours: {col:staffing.plan_hours}, of which {col:staffing.dayof_hours} on the day.
Planned labour cost: {col:staffing.plan_cost}, which is {col:staffing.hours_pg} hours per guest. Second coordinator check: {col:staffing.has_second}.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Handover note for an event
paragraphs: Handover note of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Event {col:events.event_id}: {col:events.name} for {col:events.client} on {col:events.date} at {col:events.venue}, {col:events.guests_now} guests.

Lead: {col:events.lead}. Second coordinator: {col:events.second}. Open tasks: {col:events.open_tasks}. Handover due: {col:events.handover_due}. Hours logged: {col:events.labour_hours} of {col:events.planned_hours} planned.
The task list, the vendor list and the run-of-show (event timeline) are attached. Please confirm that you have read them before the handover date.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Freelance crew booking confirmation
paragraphs: Crew booking confirmation of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Crew member: {col:crewbk.crew}. Event {col:crewbk.event_id}: {col:crewbk.event_name}, on {col:crewbk.date}.
Hours booked: {col:crewbk.hours}. Day rate: {col:crewbk.day_rate}, which is {col:crewbk.cost_hour} per hour. Pay check: {col:crewbk.pay_flag}.
Your call time and the briefing are sent separately. Payment follows after the event once your hours are confirmed.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Leave approval note
paragraphs: Leave approval note of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Person: {col:leave.person}. Kind of leave: {col:leave.kind}. From {col:leave.from_date} to {col:leave.to_date}, {col:leave.days_away} working days.
Events affected: {col:leave.events_affected}. Covered by: {col:leave.covered_by}. Approved: {col:leave.approved}.
The cover person receives the task list and the handover note of every event in the leave before the first day.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Team meeting notes
paragraphs: Team meeting notes of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Meeting {col:meetings.meeting_id} on {col:meetings.date}. Topic: {col:meetings.topic}.
Decision: {col:meetings.decision}. Owner: {col:meetings.owner}. Due date: {col:meetings.due_date}. State: {col:meetings.state}, {col:meetings.days_open} days open.
Each decision has one owner and one date. Open decisions are read out at the start of the next meeting.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Performance feedback note
paragraphs: Performance feedback note of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Person: {col:feedback.person}. Month: {col:feedback.month}. Focus: {col:feedback.focus}.
Event review average: {col:feedback.event_reviews}. Tasks done on time: {col:feedback.on_time}. Score: {col:feedback.score}, band: {col:feedback.band}. Notes: {col:feedback.notes}.
We agree one thing to keep doing and one thing to change before the next review.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Payroll summary for the owner
paragraphs: Payroll summary of {set:company}, dated {today}.

Month: {col:payroll.month}. This line: {col:payroll.staff}, {col:payroll.role}. Gross pay {col:payroll.gross_pay}, employer cost {col:payroll.employer_cost}, total cost {col:payroll.total_cost}, paid on {col:payroll.paid_on}.
Payroll of the whole month: {col:payroll.month_total}. Owner draw of the month: {col:payroll.owner_draw}.
Please check the totals and approve the payment. Figures come from the Payroll and Owner Pay sheets.
documents.note: Sample wording, adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Hiring proposal
paragraphs: Hiring proposal of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Role: {col:hiring.role}. Needed from {col:hiring.needed_from}. Status: {col:hiring.status}. Reason: {col:hiring.reason}.
Cost per month: {col:hiring.cost_month}. Hiring trigger: {col:hiring.trigger} events per person a year. Events a year needed to pay for the role: {col:hiring.break_even}.
Please approve or decline this hire. The Hiring Trigger and New Coordinator calculators show the numbers behind it.

ar.Know who is overloaded and what each eve: تعرف على الأشخاص المثقلين وما هي تكلفة كل حدث في المخاض

ar.Capacity check before you say yes: فحص السعة قبل أن تقول نعم
ar.type the event type, the guests and the: اكتب نوع الحدث والضيوف والأسابيع المتبقية واطلع على الساعات التي يحتاجها ومن لديه أكبر مساحة في الأسابيع الأربعة القادمة وما إذا كان بإمكان الفريق استيعابها

ar.every task of every event with its owner: كل مهمة لكل حدث مع مالكها، والأيام حتى تاريخ الاستحقاق، والأيام المتأخرة، وعلامة متأخرة أو محظورة، يتم حسابها من إعداد يوم الاستحقاق الخاص بك
ar.Task templates counted back from the eve: قوالب المهام محسوبة من تاريخ الحدث

ar.hours logged against the hours planned,: الساعات المسجلة مقابل الساعات المخططة، وتكلفة العمالة ورسوم التخطيط لكل ساعة لكل حدث، مع وضع علامة عندما لا تغطي الرسوم العمالة
ar.lead, second coordinator, crew, planned: القائد والمنسق الثاني والطاقم والساعات المخططة وتكلفة العمالة المخططة لكل حدث، وتحذير عندما لا يكون للحدث منسق ثانٍ
ar.the reason a task is stuck, what blocks: سبب توقف المهمة، وما الذي يمنعها، وتاريخ الاستحقاق الجديد، ومن يساعد والأيام المحظورة
ar.the working days away, the events of tha: أيام العمل البعيدة، أحداث ذلك الشخص في تلك الأيام ومن يغطيها، باستخدام آلة حاسبة تتقاسم ساعات التغطية بين المساعدين
ar.Ownership calendar with a double-booking: تقويم المسؤوليات مع فحص الحجز المزدوج

ar.One row per crew member and event with t: صف واحد لكل فرد من أفراد الطاقم والحدث مع معدل اليوم والساعات وتاريخ الدفع؛ التكلفة لكل ساعة، والعلم غير المدفوع، وملء هاتف الطاقم.

ru.Check Team: the owner planner, the coord: Команда проверки: владелец-планировщик, координаторы и внештатная команда с еженедельными часами, оплатой и стоимостью часов. Открытые задачи, просроченные задачи, часы и свободные часы заполняются сами собой.

ru.Create the tasks of a new event from Tas: Создайте задачи нового события из Шаблоны задач и Сроки выполнения задачи, затем введите их в Задачи, указав владельца, дату выполнения и расчетное время.
ru.Log hours on Staff Hours the same day. T: Запишите часы Часы работы персонала в тот же день. Они кормят Недельная мощность, Стоимость рабочей силы по мероприятиям, Загрузка по человеку и Сводка производительности.
ru.Read Weekly Capacity every Monday: plann: Читайте Недельная мощность каждый понедельник: запланированные часы в сравнении с имеющимися часами, с учетом отпуска и проверкой загрузки.
ru.Record every late or stuck task on Overd: Записывайте каждую просроченную или зависшую задачу в Просрочено и заблокировано с указанием причины, нового срока выполнения и списка тех, кто помогает.
ru.Plan every event on Event Staffing Plan: Планируйте каждое мероприятие на Штатное расписание мероприятия со вторым координатором и командой и забронируйте команду на Бронирование внештатных бригад.

ru.Use Training and Skills, Performance and: Используйте «Обучение и навыки», «Производительность» и «Командные встречи», чтобы хранить отзывы, оценки и решения с владельцами и сроками.
ru.Keep Payroll, Owner Pay and Hiring Plan: Поддерживайте актуальность расчета заработной платы, Плата владельцу и План найма. Триггер найма и Новый координатор показывают, когда нанимать и сколько это стоит.
ru.Use the 14 calculators before you decide: Используйте 14 калькуляторов, прежде чем принять решение: проверка мощности, необходимое количество часов, доходность, поиск перегрузки, сроки выполнения задач, дневное штатное расписание, сверхурочные, найм, новый координатор, стоимость бригады, покрытие отпусков, проверка на конфликты, расчет заработной платы и таблица возможных вариантов размера команды.
ru.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Распечатайте 10 листов и 10 документов, следуйте 10 контрольным спискам и коснитесь ссылки на сообщение, чтобы открыть чат с уже написанным текстом (28 сообщений).
ru.Read Team and Capacity Dashboard and Cha: Каждую неделю читайте Панель управления командой и возможностями и графики: задачи, часы, нагрузка, стоимость рабочей силы, заработная плата и почасовая оплата.
ru.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Все выпадающие списки книги. Измените пункт здесь — он обновится на всех листах.
ru.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Данные обновляются по вашим листам. Измените год, чтобы посмотреть прошлые периоды.
ru.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Выберите значение в жёлтой ячейке — остальные заполнятся автоматически. Готово к печати.
ru.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Измените текст здесь; слова в скобках подставляются из каждой строки. Ссылки находятся в таблицах.
ru.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Выберите запись — для каждого этапа появится срок. Создайте копию листа для каждой записи.
ru.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Актуальные диаграммы по данным ваших листов. Выберите значения в жёлтых ячейках — диаграммы и индикаторы обновятся автоматически.

Sehen Sie sich die Kosten für das erste Jahr, die damit erzielte Marge und die Gewinnschwelle an.
de.Extra events they can run in a year: Zusätzliche Veranstaltungen können in einem Jahr durchgeführt werden

de.Day rate you quote to the crew: Tagessatz, den Sie der Crew nennen

de.Events the team can run in a year: Veranstaltungen, die das Team in einem Jahr durchführen kann

de.Open Start and type your company name an: Öffnen Sie Start und geben Sie Ihren Firmennamen und Ihre eigenen Grenzen in die gelben Zellen ein: die wöchentliche Kapazität, den Lastanteil, der als überlastet gilt, die Stundenkosten des Koordinators, den Besatzungssatz und den Einstellungsauslöser.
de.Check Team: the owner planner, the coord: Check-Team: der Eigentümerplaner, die Koordinatoren und das freiberufliche Team mit wöchentlichen Stunden, Bezahlung und Stundenkosten. Offene Aufgaben, überfällige Aufgaben, Stunden und freie Stunden ergänzen sich von selbst.
de.Keep Events current: lead, status, guest: Halten Sie Veranstaltungen auf dem neuesten Stand: Lead, Status, Gäste und Planungsgebühr. Geplante Stunden, protokollierte Stunden, das Honorar pro Stunde und das Übergabedatum eintragen.

de.Read Weekly Capacity every Monday: plann: Lesen Sie jeden Montag Wochenkapazität: geplante Stunden im Vergleich zu den verfügbaren Stunden, mit abgezogenem Urlaub und der Auslastungsprüfung.
de.Record every late or stuck task on Overd: Erfassen Sie jede verspätete oder feststeckende Aufgabe am Überfällig und blockiert mit dem Grund, dem neuen Fälligkeitsdatum und der Person, die hilft.

de.Enter leave on Leave with who covers. Ev: Geben Sie „Urlaub auf Urlaub“ mit dem Versicherer ein. „Betroffene Ereignisse“ zeigt die Ereignisse dieser Person in diesen Tagen.
de.Use Training and Skills, Performance and: Verwenden Sie Ausbildung und Fähigkeiten, Leistung und Teambesprechungen, um Bewertungen, Feedback und Entscheidungen mit Eigentümern und Terminen zu teilen.

de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, befolgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Chat mit dem bereits geschriebenen Text zu öffnen (28 Nachrichten).
